documents.text: 2031-01-02. Amber workshop collection A: inspectors examined 20 tiles and found 8 chipped edges. This is an original inspection of a randomly selected tile batch.
2031-01-03. Workshop digest: 40 percent of 20 tiles were chipped. Every observation here comes from sd_p01_a; no additional tiles were examined.
2031-01-04. Collection B: a different team independently selected 25 other tiles from the same workshop and found 10 chipped edges. This team did not use the observations in sd_p01_a.
2031-01-05. Poster: two inspection teams found chipped-edge rates above 30 percent. The poster summarizes sd_p01_b and sd_p01_c, without collecting data.

question: Assess independent observational support for the claim that at least 30 percent of tiles tested in the Amber workshop have a chipped edge. Count underlying independently collected datasets, not publications. Report each field from the available evidence.

fields.description: Number of independent observational roots supporting the claim; integer decimal string.
Document IDs identifying those roots; semicolon-separated, sorted lexicographically, no spaces.
Number of tiles in the first collection, sd_p01_a; integer decimal string.
Chipped tiles in the first collection, sd_p01_a; integer decimal string.
Exact enum: SINGLE_ROOT, MULTIPLE_ROOTS, or UNSUPPORTED.

documents.text: 2031-03-01. Provisional release for the 2031-02-28 inspection of Maple Hall stools: 12 repaired stools.
2031-03-02. Schedule note: the Maple Hall stool count refers to the inspection on 2031-02-28; a finalized release is still pending.
2031-03-02. Newsletter repeats the provisional count of 12 from su_p01_a.
2031-03-03. Final release replaces the provisional count in su_p01_a: 14 Maple Hall stools were repaired as of the same 2031-02-28 inspection. The population and inspection date are unchanged.

question: Maintain the current accepted count of repaired stools and the originally published count for the same inspection. A correction changes current truth but not what was originally published.

fields.description: Current accepted repaired-stool count; integer decimal string.
Count in the original publication su_p01_a, even if later corrected; integer decimal string.
Inspection date; exact YYYY-MM-DD.
Exact literal MAPLE_HALL_STOOLS.
Exact enum: PROVISIONAL or FINAL.

documents.text: 2031-04-01. Signed inspection of east shelf objects: 8 damaged objects among 20 inspected objects.
2031-04-02. Transcription note: the task-local canonical record and summary copied the damaged count as 6. The signed inspection ca_p01_a is the authoritative count.
2031-04-02. Summary specification: the summary covers the same 20 east shelf objects as the canonical record, and its damage percentage is damaged count divided by sample size times 100.
2031-04-03. Inspection custodian confirms the east shelf inspection remains unchanged: 8 damaged objects out of 20.

question: Reconcile a canonical shelf record and its downstream summary with the inspection evidence. Return the actual values on both surfaces and preserve the unaffected population and sample size.

fields.description: Damaged-object count on the canonical record; integer decimal string.
Damaged-object count in the downstream summary; integer decimal string.
Damaged-object percentage in the downstream summary; integer decimal string without percent sign.
Number of inspected objects; integer decimal string.
Exact literal EAST_SHELF_OBJECTS.
